claims.text: The models using α-entmax and 1.5-entmax achieve 75% and 90% of the training speed of the standard softmax model, respectively.
The adaptive model shows a median confidence of 95.9%, indicating effective performance compared to baseline models.
The ability of the adaptive model to learn different sparsity patterns suggests improved performance over fixed-sparsity models.
